Priya Patel: Heads up — planning an egress migration + warm node drain next Tue 2026-04-06 01:00-03:00 UTC. Affects eu-west2 GPU pools (nvidia-a100-48) for ~2h as we move egress IPs and apply routing rules. We'll do rolling pod evictions with 15m stagger; target <5% capacity impacted at any time. Reason: cloud provider is retiring the legacy egress gateway and the new path needs MTU and QoS tweaks.
Sam Nguyen: ETA on capacity backfill? do we have spare nodes / spot budget?
Priya Patel: yes — 24 spare GPUs across eu-west2 + eu-central. Plan: shift burst capacity from eu-central first. Spot backfill only for non‑SLA workloads. Estimated cost delta if spots fail: ~+$1.5k for the window (network egress + temporary reserved spins).
Lena Ortiz: Can we avoid moving reserved pools? last time moving caused higher cold-cache token cost and regressed tail latency.
Priya Patel: We'll pin reserved pools; only ephemeral/burst pools move. Also we'll pre-warm prefix/KV cache with a 30m sampling job to limit cold-token penalty. Command for warmup: ```scripts/prefix_warmup --pool eu-west2 --duration 30m```
Marc Chen: ops-oncall will you own post-migration smoke tests? Need p50/p95 latency, KV cache hit rate, and a couple of end-to-end sample prompts.
ops-oncall: oncall here — yes. I'll run smoke: ```./run_smoke.sh eu-west2 --checks latency,kv_hit,throughput``` and post results to #incidents. Alert if anything >2x baseline.
infra-bot: Maintenance scheduled by Priya Patel for 2026-04-06 01:00-03:00 UTC. Status page: https://status.redwood.com/uptime/maintenance/2432105678. Reminders posted 24h and 1h prior.
Sam Nguyen: one risk: partner VPC egress ACLs — need partner ops signoff before IP flip. Priya can you loop in partnerships?
Priya Patel: looping in @Elena Marino (partnerships) for ACL signoff and partner comms. Elena — can you confirm partner ACLs accept new IPs by EOD?
Elena Marino: I can chase two partners today. One already approved the IP ranges, the other needs an ACL update — should be done tomorrow EOD. Noted.
Lena Ortiz: Also flagging scheduler cost tradeoff: if spots don't fill we should preempt low-priority eval jobs to free capacity. I can flip a preemptive flag on the scheduler for the window.
Marc Chen: +1. Add a runbook step: 'preempt-eval-jobs' and an operator toggle. Also add a quick rollback: re-point egress to legacy path if we see >15% error rate for 10m.
Priya Patel: TL;DR: scheduled Tue 01:00-03:00 UTC eu-west2, rolling warm-drain with 15m stagger, reserved pools pinned, pre-warm cache, ops smoke tests, partner ACL signoff, preempt evals if needed, rollback plan. If no objections by EOD I'll lock the window and update the calendar and status page. :thumbsup:
